jobs.description: Rich gastronomy of all sorts plus a dash of Swiss charm—that is what you will love as our chef de parti at Mövenpick in Amsterdam. Because of our international roots, our working language is English.Afternoons, evenings and weekends— all these shifts will come along.Proud to presentMövenpick: the place to enjoy life.
